result: Single-Plane Reversibility + noncommuting full SO(n) selects n=3
assumptions: SPR: every infinitesimal reversible generator has rank <=2
NCR: connected reversible dynamics is non-abelian
theorem: SPR holds for full SO(n) iff n<=3; NCR holds iff n>=3; hence SPR+NCR iff n=3.
counterexample: For every n>=4, blockdiag(J,J,0) is skew-symmetric of rank 4 and violates SPR.
novelty: Underlying skew-symmetric canonical-form and Lie-algebra mathematics is standard. SPR is a PDT-motivated candidate axiom, not yet independently derived or experimentally established.
